t: Said on arriving somewhere at first light
a: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، خَرِبَتْ خَيْبَرُ، إِنَّا إِذَا نَزَلْنَا بِسَاحَةِ قَوْمٍ فَسَاءَ صَبَاحُ الْمُنْذَرِينَ
p: Allāhu akbar, kharibat Khaybar. Innā idhā nazalnā bi-sāḥati qawmin fa-sā'a ṣabāḥu-l-mundharīn.
m: Allah is greatest. Khaybar is ruined. When we descend upon the courtyard of a people, terrible is the morning of those who were warned.
